messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Sev2 — Internal LB (ILB) cross-region routing anomalies detected for Private VPC deployments in europe-west1 <-> europe-west4. High TCP RSTs and backend unreachable spikes. Pager -> infra-oncall.

alice: I'm on it. Seeing lots of RSTs and 'backend unreachable' in our LB telemetry. Impacting ~6 customers with private deployments using cross-region backends.

samir: Confirmed from our side. Traceroute asymmetry e-w1 -> e-w4 drops after first hop. GCP LB telemetry flags BFD flaps and route withdrawals.

irene: Creating incident record INC-2026-114. Paging network. Can we get a customer list for scope?

alice: customer-success, FYI: affected customers: AcmeApp, NovaMetrics, BrightShelf, Customer-D, BetaFin, InternalTest. Notifying them now with acknowledgement.

mike (network): I'm pulling BFD and route snapshots. No infra deploys in last 3 hours on our side. Opening urgent GCP escalation.

gcp-support-bot: Support case SC-123456 opened with GCP Networking Escalation. Case owner: Maria (GCP SE). Initial response ETA ~10m.

alice: Proposed mitigations: 1) regional-pin affected customers to a single region backend where possible, 2) increase health-check thresholds to avoid transient failovers, 3) rate-limit retries client-side for bursty failures. Starting with customer AcmeApp as test.

samir: Running regional pin for AcmeApp now: 
```bash
# move traffic to europe-west1 only
gcloud compute backend-services update acme-backend-service \
  --global --connection-draining-timeout 0 \
  --backends region-europe-west1=100
```

alice: Applied for AcmeApp. Monitoring.

incident-bot: metric update: AcmeApp error rate down from 48% -> 6% within 2m after pin.

irene: Good signal. Mike, please send BFD session logs and route table snapshots to GCP.

mike (network): Partial logs attached in case: 
```
BFD session 0x7ff state DOWN->UP->DOWN
proto: received holdtimer expired
route-controller: withdraw 10.10.0.0/24 via gw
```

gcp-support-bot: GCP requested project IDs, VPC names, ILB resource ids, and VPC flow logs. Uploaded artifacts to SFTP and handed to SE.

product-ops: Need quick summary for CS / legal on SLA exposure. Short bullet please.

alice: TL;DR for CS: 6 private VPC deployments experienced intermittent ILB cross-region connectivity causing bursts of failed requests for multi-region backends. Mitigation: regional pinning for impacted customers reduced errors for tested customers; GCP investigating route replication.

samir: Applying temporary client-side retry/backoff via edge gateway to reduce user-facing 5xx while we wait for GCP to stabilize.

alice: Handoff note — I'm offline in 30m. Irene will take over incident lead, Samir remains on network debugging. Irene, accept?

irene: Accepting handoff. Action items I own: liaise with GCP until route controller confirms stable, coordinate CS comms, maintain mitigations (regional pins), collect timelines for postmortem.

gcp-support-bot: GCP update (t+24m): observed internal route controller replication lag caused by transient API throttling. Engineers performing a targeted re-sync of internal route state. ETA ~35m for global convergence.

customer-success: Sending interim customer note: "We are aware of intermittent internal load balancer connectivity for some Private VPC setups. We have applied regional routing mitigations and are working with our cloud provider. Next update in 30m." 

alice: Small config tweak to reduce flapping: increase TCP healthcheck thresholds for affected backend services: 
```yaml
healthCheck:
  type: tcp
  checkIntervalSec: 5
  healthyThreshold: 5
  unhealthyThreshold: 2
```

samir: Confirmed applied to AcmeApp and NovaMetrics backends. Monitoring for stabilization.

incident-bot: status update (t+45m): affected customer count reduced to 1 (Customer-D). Route replication metrics show improvement.

irene: We'll keep pins in place until GCP confirms 2 consecutive stable intervals. If GCP can't confirm root cause within 2 hours escalate to SE manager. Documenting all changes for rollback.

gcp-support-bot: GCP follow-up (t+60m): re-sync completed, internal metrics show routes converged. They asked us to validate for 15m and confirm.

customer-success: Confirmed Customer-D reports recovered after regional pin applied. Sending recovery notice.

alice: I'll draft initial timeline and assign postmortem owner (samir) for networking root cause analysis. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

gcp-support-bot: GCP marks case SC-123456 as "mitigated" pending customer confirmation. Please reopen if any recurrence.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Keep channel for follow-ups and postmortem.
